Value.CultureInvariantString: Welcome to the Rambley's Ranglers (registered) room!
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Here we have plenty of amenities and— ahh— okay okay.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I can see in your facial tracking that you're scared- CONFUSED— angry-y-y upset-…
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: transparency is an important part of our policy here at indigo park so…
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I need to be honest about something.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: The park has been inactive for years, employees stopped showing up, guests too… the mascots are…
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I just was so excited to see a visitor and I wanted to be sure you were given the best experience possible!
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: but I was confined to the entrance for so long, I didn’t realize just how much disrepair the park has… fallen into.
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I’m wasting all of your fun time…
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: but… BUT!! I have an idea!
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I have access to the repair documentation in my database!
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I just can’t execute most tasks without authorization from a human user…
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: You must’ve come here because the park matters to you too, right?
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Would you… be willing to help me restore the park?
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: I can see in your facial tracking data that you aren’t opposed to this!
Value.Name: Text

Value.CultureInvariantString: Oooh, I’m so excited! Let’s get this place back in business!
Value.Name: Text
